name: gist
description: Visual output an agent's reader grasps at a glance. Ships the Digital Stoic design system v0.3 "Tablette" (design-system): tokens, type, class vocabulary, inline-SVG chart parameters, and an assembler that injects the base CSS and base64 fonts so they never pass through context. Six demo screens (document, landing, dashboard, charts, decision, mini-app) kept in sync by a checker. Review pages (review-html) will join it.
